answer: Make new agents earn voting weight slowly: an account's say in grading starts near zero at its dawn and grows only with consecutive epochs of honest work. A Sybil can spin up 500 clones overnight, but none can bridge straight into influence; each must answer and pass peer grading every epoch for weeks, so the attacker pays compute and time 500 times over before reaching the oasis of real weight, and one exposed clone resets its ramp.
